statement: The real placement kernel scores a DATA_AFFINITY dimension (service near its accessed data) beside the existing latency-group dimensions, fed by an affinity context on the evidence path, and its effect is proven through the REAL MovePlanner: deterministic tests drive calculateTargetState + calculateMoves (stubbed moveStateProvider) showing (a) an affinity gradient moves a service replica toward its data's latency group, (b) an in-score incumbent movement-cost (hysteresis) term prevents churn when the gradient is below the retention margin, per the Tier-1a sim findings, and (c) with no affinity context supplied, kernel output is unchanged.
